title: Đề 3 – cấu trúc đề tốt nghiệp
desc: 40 câu, 50 phút. Chủ đề: việc làm thêm, hội thảo bảo tàng, bình đẳng giới trong STEM, sông băng tan, robot và việc làm.

sections.title: Câu 1–6
sections.instruction: Đọc quảng cáo và chọn phương án đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: Part-time job
items.passage:
PART-TIME STAFF WANTED – GREEN LEAF CAFÉ
Are you a friendly, hard-working student looking for a part-time job? We are looking (1) ___ energetic young people to join our team. No experience is necessary – we will give you full (2) ___. You will serve customers, prepare drinks and keep the café clean. We offer (3) ___ working hours, so you can fit work around your studies. Staff also receive a free drink every shift and a 50% discount (4) ___ all food. If you are interested, please send your CV (5) ___ hr@greenleafcafe.vn. Only candidates (6) ___ are selected will be contacted.

items.explain: look for: tìm kiếm.
give full training: đào tạo đầy đủ (danh từ).
Trước danh từ working hours cần tính từ: flexible.
a discount on something: giảm giá cho cái gì.
send something to an address.
Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ người: candidates who are selected.

sections.title: Câu 7–12
sections.instruction: Đọc thông báo và chọn phương án đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: Museum workshop
items.passage:
WEEKEND WORKSHOP: DISCOVER OLD HANOI
The Ha Noi Museum is pleased to (7) ___ a special workshop for students aged 15–18. Participants will explore the history of the city through old maps, photographs and (8) ___ objects. The workshop will be led by an experienced historian (9) ___ has written several books about Ha Noi. At the end of the day, students will work in groups to (10) ___ a short presentation. The workshop is free, but places are limited, so early registration is (11) ___ recommended. Please register at the information desk (12) ___ Friday 5th May.

items.explain: be pleased + to V: to announce.
Trước danh từ objects cần tính từ: historical objects.
historian (người) làm chủ ngữ: who.
to + động từ nguyên mẫu: to prepare.
Trước động từ phân từ recommended cần trạng từ: strongly recommended.
by + thời hạn: trước/không muộn hơn thứ Sáu.

sections.title: Câu 23–30
sections.instruction: Đọc bài và chọn đáp án đúng.

items.title: Melting glaciers
items.passage:
High in the Himalayas, glaciers – huge rivers of ice – have existed for thousands of years. They store water in winter and release it slowly in summer, feeding great rivers such as the Ganges and the Mekong. More than a billion people depend on these rivers for drinking water, farming and electricity.

Today, these glaciers are melting faster than ever before. A recent study found that Himalayan glaciers lost ice ten times more quickly over the past few decades than during the previous seven centuries. The main cause is global warming, which is driven by greenhouse gases from burning coal, oil and gas.

In the short term, melting ice can actually increase the amount of water in rivers. In the long term, however, the situation is worrying. As the glaciers shrink, there will be less water during the dry season, threatening crops and hydroelectric power. Melting ice can also create new lakes that may suddenly burst, causing dangerous floods in valleys below.

Scientists say that the only way to slow down the melting is to cut greenhouse gas emissions around the world. At the same time, mountain communities need help to adapt, for example by building early warning systems for floods and storing water more efficiently.

items.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: The melting of Himalayan glaciers and its effects
The history of the Mekong River
items.explain: Bài nói sông băng tan nhanh và hệ quả.

items.prompt: According to paragraph 1, what do glaciers do?
options: They store water in winter and release it in summer.
items.explain: "They store water in winter and release it slowly in summer".

items.prompt: The word "depend on" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to ___.
items.explain: depend on = rely on (dựa vào).

items.prompt: What is the main cause of the melting, according to the passage?
items.explain: "The main cause is global warming".

items.prompt: The word "which" in paragraph 2 refers to ___.
items.explain: "global warming, which is driven by greenhouse gases".

items.prompt: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a long-term danger?
options: Less water in the dry season
Threats to crops and hydroelectric power
items.explain: Bài không nói động đất.

items.prompt: Which best paraphrases "In the short term, melting ice can actually increase the amount of water in rivers"?
options: For a while, rivers may have more water because of the melting ice.
Rivers will always have more water in the future.
items.explain: Trong ngắn hạn, sông có thể nhiều nước hơn.

items.prompt: According to the last paragraph, how can mountain communities adapt?
options: By building early warning systems for floods
items.explain: "building early warning systems for floods".

sections.title: Câu 31–40
sections.instruction: Đọc bài và chọn đáp án đúng.

items.title: Will robots take our jobs?
items.passage:
Robots and artificial intelligence are changing the workplace at an incredible speed. In factories, robotic arms assemble cars and electronics faster and more accurately than humans. In offices, software can now answer customer emails, analyse data and even write simple reports. It is no surprise that many young people worry about whether there will be jobs for them in the future.

History, however, offers some comfort. When machines were introduced during the Industrial Revolution, many workers feared they would lose their jobs, and some did. [I] Yet over time, new industries appeared and created millions of new jobs that nobody could have imagined before. [II] Economists believe that something similar will happen with AI. [III] Jobs such as app developer, data analyst and social media manager did not exist thirty years ago. [IV]

That does not mean the change will be easy. Jobs that involve repetitive tasks, such as data entry or simple assembly work, are most at risk. In contrast, jobs that require creativity, emotional intelligence or complex problem-solving are much harder to automate. Nurses, teachers, designers and engineers, for example, will still be needed, although they may use AI as a helpful tool.

So how can students prepare? Experts recommend developing skills that machines cannot easily copy, such as critical thinking, communication and teamwork. Learning how to work with technology is equally important. Above all, young people should be ready to keep learning throughout their careers, because the jobs of tomorrow may look very different from those of today.

items.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How robots and AI will change jobs and how to prepare
items.explain: Bài bàn về AI, việc làm và cách chuẩn bị.

items.prompt: According to paragraph 1, what can software do in offices?
items.explain: "software can now answer customer emails, analyse data…".

items.prompt: The word "assemble" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to ___.
items.explain: assemble = lắp ráp (put together).

items.prompt: Where in paragraph 2 does the following sentence best fit? "In other words, the machines of that time changed jobs rather than simply destroying them."
items.explain: "the machines of that time" chỉ máy móc thời Cách mạng công nghiệp: câu tóm lại ý ngành mới tạo việc làm mới, nên đặt ở [II], ngay sau câu đó và trước khi chuyển sang AI.

items.prompt: Why does the writer mention jobs such as app developer and data analyst?
options: To show that new technology creates new kinds of jobs
To show that these jobs are well paid
To show that these jobs will disappear
To show that young people dislike them
items.explain: Các nghề này 30 năm trước chưa có: công nghệ tạo nghề mới.

items.prompt: Which jobs are most at risk, according to paragraph 3?
items.explain: "Jobs that involve repetitive tasks… are most at risk".

items.prompt: The phrase "In contrast" in paragraph 3 introduces ___.
items.explain: In contrast: ngược lại.

items.prompt: The word "they" in paragraph 3 refers to ___.
items.explain: "Nurses, teachers… will still be needed, although they may use AI".

items.prompt: Which of the following is NOT recommended by experts?
options: Continuing to learn throughout one's career
items.explain: Chuyên gia khuyên học cách làm việc với công nghệ, không khuyên tránh hẳn.

items.prompt: It can be inferred from the passage that the writer is ___ about the future of work.
items.explain: Tin sẽ có việc mới nhưng thừa nhận thay đổi không dễ.
